targets.title: Hodge conjecture
targets.statement: For every smooth complex projective variety, every rational Hodge class of type (p,p) is a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles.
proof_obligations: Handle every smooth complex projective variety and every codimension.
Construct algebraic cycle representatives with exact hypotheses.
A verified finite matrix or a special family does not establish the general conjecture.

targets.title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
targets.statement: Construct nontrivial quantum Yang-Mills theory on four-dimensional Euclidean space for every compact simple gauge group, satisfying the required axioms, with a strictly positive mass gap.
proof_obligations: Construct the continuum theory and prove all required axioms.
Control renormalization and nontriviality uniformly at physical scales.
A finite lattice spectral gap alone is insufficient.

targets.title: Riemann hypothesis
targets.statement: Every nontrivial zero of the analytic continuation of the Riemann zeta function has real part one half.
proof_obligations: Prove the statement for every nontrivial zero, including unbounded heights.
Justify all analytic continuations, limits and equivalences.
A finite zero computation is insufficient.

targets.title: Reflexive-polytope descent D4 and proposed bound 24
targets.statement: Assess the proposed upper bound D_4 <= 24 for the maximum shortest reflexive-cover descent depth across four-dimensional reflexive polytopes. The exact value requires matching bounds.
proof_obligations: Define the genuine cover relation and verify every descent step.
Supply complete coverage of the classification with bounds at most 24.
A bound of 50 or 346 does not establish a bound of 24; matching lower bounds are required for an exact value.

targets.title: D4 lattice and the 24-point kissing configuration
targets.statement: Verify the 24 D4 root vectors form a kissing configuration in dimension four. Distinguish this construction from a universal upper bound or uniqueness theorem.
proof_obligations: Verify all 24 vectors have the same norm and every distinct pair satisfies the angular separation condition.
An optimality proof additionally rules out all configurations with at least 25 points.
Attribute existing optimality and uniqueness results; reconstructing a known configuration is not a new breakthrough.

targets.title: Four-dimensional sphere packing and the 24-cell bound
targets.statement: Prove that no packing of unit balls in four-dimensional Euclidean space has upper density exceeding pi^2/16, attained by the scaled D4 lattice.
proof_obligations: Cover arbitrary centers in R^4, including nonperiodic packings and centers off a fixed grid.
For a Voronoi proof, justify passing to saturated packings and a uniform lower bound of 8 for every central cell, including nonroot directions and multiple extra centers.
For a density proof using a different method, control the asymptotic density uniformly over translated windows.
